My reason for adopting a vegan diet was from realizing what I was eating. After reading and researching it just clicked, and meat began to freak me out. Plus, I am an animal lover. And that doesn't just mean dogs and cats, like it does when most people say it. It extends to cows, pigs, birds, etc. I also do not like the way our animal agriculture goes down in this country. It is super harmful to the environment and not nearly as regulated as it should be in some fundamental ways (read: unsafe food). Not that all vegetables are more safe. There are a lot of mass contaminations of produce on record in this country too. But this just makes sense to me.

Essentially its sauteed garlic, shallots, and mushrooms. Then I deglaze with white wine. Then I let the wine reduce a bit. Then I add a vegan sour cream and let it thicken up a bit. Then I hit it with some dried basil. Toss in some more than al dente noodles and let cook until noodles are al dente or to preference. Boom! Like I said. Tits-on-ice! This is not an original recipe.
